card.name: Sediment and professor/title words in science text
card.fires_on: The word sediment (or nearby linking words) in environmental risk-assessment text, and words after a job title like professor or goalkeeper before a person's name.

modes.label: Sediment quality text
modes.description: The word sediment or nearby punctuation in environmental contaminant assessment passages.

modes.label: Before a person's name
modes.description: A small word after a job title or speech verb, just before a named person.
modes.example: Cornell professor<< of>> molecular biology and genetics

card.plain: It fires on sediment in environmental studies and on small words that lead into a named expert, with no single clear theme.
